question: How many users are currently active on our platform?
origin_context: Tests implicit status rule for active users.
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_users FROM users WHERE status = 1;

question: How many bookings did we get last month?
origin_context: Tests dynamic temporal math without hardcoded dates.
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_bookings FROM bookings WHERE YEAR(created_at) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND MONTH(created_at) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 1 MONTH);

question: Are there any good restaurants in Colachel?
origin_context: Tests schema quirk handling ('Restaurent') and rating aggregation.
golden_sql: SELECT sd.name, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM shop_details sd JOIN subcategories sc ON sc.id = sd.subcategory_id JOIN shop_address sa ON sa.shop_id = sd.id JOIN reviews r ON r.shop_id = sd.id WHERE sd.status = 1 AND sa.is_default = 1 AND sa.city = 'Colachel' AND sc.subcategoryname = 'Restaurent' GROUP BY sd.id, sd.name HAVING AVG(r.rating) >= 4 ORDER BY avg_rating DESC;

question: Give me the phone number for A1 Juice house.
origin_context: Basic entity lookup with active filter.
golden_sql: SELECT phone FROM shop_details WHERE name = 'A1 Juice house' AND status = 1 LIMIT 1;

question: Who bought a premium plan and also left a 5-star review for a cafe in Trivandrum?
origin_context: 6-table join test with fuzzy city mapping.
golden_sql: SELECT DISTINCT u.name FROM users u JOIN plans p ON u.plan_id = p.id JOIN reviews r ON r.user_id = u.id JOIN shop_details sd ON sd.id = r.shop_id JOIN shop_address sa ON sa.shop_id = sd.id JOIN subcategories sc ON sc.id = sd.subcategory_id WHERE r.rating = 5 AND sa.city IN ('Trivandrum', 'Thiruvananthapuram') AND sa.is_default = 1 AND sc.subcategoryname LIKE '%cafe%';

question: Show me all the vegan restaurants.
origin_context: Tests negative space / zero-result handling when category doesn't exist.
golden_sql: SELECT sd.name FROM shop_details sd JOIN subcategories sc ON sc.id = sd.subcategory_id WHERE sc.subcategoryname LIKE '%vegan%';

question: Which shop made the most revenue from completed bookings this year?
origin_context: Tests current year aggregation and booking status filtering.
golden_sql: SELECT sd.name, SUM(b.final_amount) AS total_revenue FROM shop_details sd JOIN bookings b ON b.shop_id = sd.id WHERE YEAR(b.created_at) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AND b.status = 1 GROUP BY sd.id, sd.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: List the top 5 most viewed offers.
origin_context: Fact table join with dimension aggregation.
golden_sql: SELECT o.offer_heading, COUNT(v.id) AS view_count FROM offer o JOIN views v ON v.offer_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 1 GROUP BY o.id, o.offer_heading ORDER BY view_count DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Count how many categories we have.
origin_context: Tests visible status filter on categories.
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_categories FROM categories WHERE visible_status = 1;

question: Show me the top 3 cities with the highest number of 5-star reviews.
origin_context: Multi-table join focusing on default address grouping.
golden_sql: SELECT sa.city, COUNT(r.id) AS five_star_count FROM reviews r JOIN shop_address sa ON sa.shop_id = r.shop_id WHERE r.rating = 5 AND sa.is_default = 1 GROUP BY sa.city ORDER BY five_star_count DESC LIMIT 3;

question: Did we get any new reviews today?
origin_context: Tests dynamic date filtering for current day reviews.
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS reviews_today FROM reviews WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURRENT_DATE;

question: What's the cheapest offer available at any restaurant in Nagercoil right now?
origin_context: Heavy multi-table filter testing restaurant quirk and min price logic.
golden_sql: SELECT o.offer_heading, o.offer_price, sd.name FROM offer o JOIN shop_details sd ON sd.id = o.shop_id JOIN shop_address sa ON sa.shop_id = sd.id JOIN subcategories sc ON sc.id = sd.subcategory_id WHERE o.status = 1 AND sd.status = 1 AND sa.is_default = 1 AND sa.city = 'Nagercoil' AND sc.subcategoryname = 'Restaurent' AND o.offer_price = (SELECT MIN(o2.offer_price) FROM offer o2 JOIN shop_details sd2 ON sd2.id = o2.shop_id JOIN shop_address sa2 ON sa2.shop_id = sd2.id JOIN subcategories sc2 ON sc2.id = sd2.subcategory_id WHERE o2.status = 1 AND sd2.status = 1 AND sa2.is_default = 1 AND sa2.city = 'Nagercoil' AND sc2.subcategoryname = 'Restaurent');

question: How many users have a subscription plan right now?
origin_context: Checking subscription status via foreign key existence.
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS subscribed_users FROM users WHERE plan_id IS NOT NULL AND status = 1;

question: Which category has the highest average booking amount?
origin_context: Traversing bookings up to categories with average aggregation.
golden_sql: SELECT c.categoriesname, ROUND(AVG(b.final_amount), 2) AS avg_booking_amt FROM categories c JOIN shop_details sd ON sd.category_id = c.id JOIN bookings b ON b.shop_id = sd.id GROUP BY c.id, c.categoriesname ORDER BY avg_booking_amt DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Find all active shops that have a default address but no phone number listed.
origin_context: Testing missing text field handling alongside default filters.
golden_sql: SELECT sd.name, sa.city FROM shop_details sd JOIN shop_address sa ON sa.shop_id = sd.id WHERE sd.status = 1 AND sa.is_default = 1 AND (sd.phone IS NULL OR sd.phone = '');

question: What is the average discount given on bookings for each city?
origin_context: Aggregation across joined geographic tables.
golden_sql: SELECT sa.city, ROUND(AVG(b.discount), 2) AS avg_discount FROM bookings b JOIN shop_address sa ON sa.shop_id = b.shop_id WHERE sa.is_default = 1 GROUP BY sa.city ORDER BY avg_discount DESC;

question: I want to see the names of people who booked an offer at 'Timepass' and left a review less than 3 stars.
origin_context: Dual interaction join on the same shop entity.
golden_sql: SELECT DISTINCT u.name FROM users u JOIN bookings b ON b.requester_id = u.id JOIN reviews r ON r.user_id = u.id JOIN shop_details sd ON sd.id = b.shop_id AND sd.id = r.shop_id WHERE sd.name = 'Timepass' AND r.rating < 3;

question: Which plan is the most popular among our users?
origin_context: Counting foreign keys grouped by primary key plan ID.
golden_sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(u.id) AS user_count FROM plans p JOIN users u ON u.plan_id = p.id WHERE u.status = 1 GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY user_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Show me the top 5 highest rated shops that have absolutely zero bookings.
origin_context: Anti-join pattern combined with aggregate average.
golden_sql: SELECT sd.name, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM shop_details sd JOIN reviews r ON r.shop_id = sd.id LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.shop_id = sd.id WHERE sd.status = 1 AND b.id IS NULL GROUP BY sd.id, sd.name HAVING AVG(r.rating) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY avg_rating DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What are the 3 most recently posted active offers?
origin_context: Simple ordering by timestamp with active status filter.
golden_sql: SELECT offer_heading, created_at FROM offer WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 3;

question: Calculate the total revenue generated by each subcategory in the last 6 months.
origin_context: Deep join with relative date math and revenue aggregation.
golden_sql: SELECT sc.subcategoryname, SUM(b.final_amount) AS total_revenue FROM subcategories sc JOIN shop_details sd ON sd.subcategory_id = sc.id JOIN bookings b ON b.shop_id = sd.id WHERE b.created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 6 MONTH) AND b.status = 1 GROUP BY sc.id, sc.subcategoryname ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

question: How many shops offer a 'free' service?
origin_context: Translating conversational term 'free' to `offer_price = 0`.
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT shop_id) AS free_shops FROM offer WHERE offer_price = 0 AND status = 1;

question: Which users have booked the exact same offer more than once?
origin_context: Multi-level grouping with HAVING clause for duplicate counts.
golden_sql: SELECT u.name, b.offer_id, COUNT(*) AS times_booked FROM bookings b JOIN users u ON u.id = b.requester_id GROUP BY b.requester_id, b.offer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

question: Are there any unverified users who have made purchases?
origin_context: Checking null verification timestamps alongside bookings join.
golden_sql: SELECT DISTINCT u.name, u.email FROM users u JOIN bookings b ON b.requester_id = u.id WHERE u.email_verified_at IS NULL;

question: Show me all active shops in Nagercoil.
origin_context: Standard active shop lookup with default address city filter.
golden_sql: SELECT sd.name FROM shop_details sd JOIN shop_address sa ON sa.shop_id = sd.id WHERE sd.status = 1 AND sa.is_default = 1 AND sa.city = 'Nagercoil';

question: How many unique users viewed an offer on the most recent day we have view data for?
origin_context: Tests data-anchored date logic for daily unique viewers. The anchor is the latest date in views, because the data is not refreshed to the current date.
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS unique_viewers FROM views WHERE created_at >= (SELECT MAX(DATE(created_at)) FROM views) AND created_at < (SELECT MAX(DATE(created_at)) FROM views) + INTERVAL 1 DAY;
must_not_rules: no CURRENT_DATE or NOW() used as the anchor

question: Which active shops have at least one active offer but no reviews yet?
origin_context: Combines a positive existence check (active offer) with an anti-join (no reviews) across three tables.
golden_sql: SELECT sd.name FROM shop_details sd WHERE sd.status = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM offer o WHERE o.shop_id = sd.id AND o.status = 1) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reviews r WHERE r.shop_id = sd.id);
must_not_rules: no shops without active offers included

question: What's the most expensive subscription plan we offer?
origin_context: Simple ordering by plan price with active filter.
golden_sql: SELECT name, price FROM plans WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Show me all the partners who are on a paid plan but have 0 active shops.
origin_context: Partners are users with user_type = 2. Paid plan means an active plan with price > 0. Anti-join against active shops.
golden_sql: SELECT u.name FROM users u JOIN plans p ON u.plan_id = p.id WHERE u.user_type = 2 AND u.status = 1 AND u.subscriber_status = 1 AND p.status = 1 AND p.price > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shop_details sd WHERE sd.partner_id = u.id AND sd.status = 1);
must_not_rules: no users with user_type other than 2

question: How much potential recurring revenue do we have from active plans?
origin_context: Sums the monthly price of active plans across users with an active subscription. All plans bill monthly.
golden_sql: SELECT SUM(p.price) AS total_mrr FROM users u JOIN plans p ON u.plan_id = p.id WHERE u.status = 1 AND u.subscriber_status = 1 AND p.status = 1;
must_not_rules: no inactive plans or users included

question: On the most recent day a booking was made, which users viewed an offer but did not book anything that day?
origin_context: Data-anchored anti-join. The anchor is the latest booking date, because views and bookings only overlap up to 2026-03.
golden_sql: SELECT DISTINCT u.name FROM users u JOIN views v ON v.user_id = u.id CROSS JOIN (SELECT MAX(DATE(created_at)) AS d FROM bookings) m WHERE v.created_at >= m.d AND v.created_at < m.d + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bookings b WHERE b.requester_id = u.id AND b.created_at >= m.d AND b.created_at < m.d + INTERVAL 1 DAY);
must_not_rules: no users who booked that day included
no CURRENT_DATE or NOW() used as the anchor

question: Which user has viewed the most offers without ever making a single booking?
origin_context: Left join anti-pattern with aggregation and ordering.
golden_sql: SELECT u.name, COUNT(v.id) AS view_count FROM users u JOIN views v ON u.id = v.user_id LEFT JOIN bookings b ON u.id = b.requester_id WHERE b.id IS NULL GROUP BY u.id, u.name ORDER BY view_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Did offer views drop in the latest 7 days of data compared to the 7 days before that?
origin_context: Conditional aggregation across two 7-day windows, anchored on the latest date in views.
golden_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN v.created_at >= m.max_day - INTERVAL 6 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS latest_7_days, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN v.created_at < m.max_day - INTERVAL 6 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS previous_7_days FROM views v CROSS JOIN (SELECT MAX(DATE(created_at)) AS max_day FROM views) m WHERE v.created_at >= m.max_day - INTERVAL 13 DAY AND v.created_at < m.max_day + INTERVAL 1 DAY;
must_not_rules: no CURRENT_DATE or NOW() used as the anchor

question: What percentage of our users with a recorded gender fall under each gender value?
origin_context: Percentage distribution over the numeric gender column. Reworded because the number-to-label mapping is unconfirmed.
golden_sql: SELECT gender, COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE gender IS NOT NULL) AS percentage FROM users WHERE gender IS NOT NULL GROUP BY gender;

question: Who are our oldest subscribers based on their start date?
origin_context: Oldest 5 users who actually hold a plan, ordered by subscription start date. NULL dates and users without a plan are excluded.
golden_sql: SELECT name, subscriber_startDate FROM users WHERE subscriber_status = 1 AND plan_id IS NOT NULL AND plan_id <> 0 AND subscriber_startDate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY subscriber_startDate ASC LIMIT 5;
must_not_rules: no users without a plan included

question: How many users signed up in the 7 days ending on the most recent signup date?
origin_context: Data-anchored 7-day window. The anchor is the latest signup date, because CURRENT_DATE returns 0 on this old data. Returns a count so no personal emails are exposed.
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_users FROM users WHERE created_at >= (SELECT MAX(DATE(created_at)) FROM users) - INTERVAL 6 DAY;
must_not_rules: no CURRENT_DATE or NOW() used as the anchor

question: Which plans allow for more than 5 products?
origin_context: Direct column comparison threshold filter.
golden_sql: SELECT name, product_limit FROM plans WHERE product_limit > 5 AND status = 1;

question: How many offer views were recorded in January 2026?
origin_context: Fixed calendar-month count on views. Expected answer is 492, from your month-by-month output.
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS view_count FROM views WHERE created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND created_at < '2026-02-01';
must_not_rules: no views from other months included

question: How many users have the word 'admin' in their email?
origin_context: String pattern matching check.
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE email LIKE '%admin%';

question: How many active users do not have a plan assigned?
origin_context: A plan_id of NULL or 0 means no plan. Expected answer is 2376, from your plan_id breakdown.
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS users_without_plan FROM users WHERE status = 1 AND (plan_id IS NULL OR plan_id = 0);
must_not_rules: no users with a valid plan included

question: How many users are on each active plan?
origin_context: Group count of users per active plan. Expected: Basic Plan 65 (63+2), Standard Plan 118 (115+3).
golden_sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(u.id) AS user_count FROM plans p JOIN users u ON u.plan_id = p.id WHERE p.status = 1 GROUP BY p.id, p.name;
must_not_rules: no users without a plan included

question: How many partners do we have?
origin_context: Partners are users with user_type = 2. Expected answer is 207.
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS partner_count FROM users WHERE user_type = 2;

question: How many bookings were made in 2025?
origin_context: Calendar-year count on bookings. Expected answer is 21 (8+4+8+1), from your month-by-month output.
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS booking_count FROM bookings WHERE created_at >= '2025-01-01' AND created_at < '2026-01-01';

question: List the names of all the plans we currently have.
origin_context: Basic lookup of active plans.
golden_sql: SELECT name FROM plans WHERE status = 1;

question: Who was the very first user to sign up on the app?
origin_context: Ordering by signup timestamp ascending.
golden_sql: SELECT name, created_at FROM users ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 1;

question: Give me an overview of all our editable offers.
origin_context: Querying the dedicated database view editable_offers_view.
golden_sql: SELECT * FROM editable_offers_view WHERE offer_status = 1 LIMIT 100;
must_not_rules: no raw table bypassing of view logic

question: Which shop has the highest number of editable offers?
origin_context: Aggregating metrics directly out of the editable_offers_view.
golden_sql: SELECT shop_name, COUNT(offer_id) AS offer_count FROM editable_offers_view WHERE offer_status = 1 GROUP BY shop_id, shop_name ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Show me the product names for the offer titled 'Summer Offer'.
origin_context: Queries offer_items_view with an exact heading match. 'Summer Offer for T-Shirt' also exists, so exact match is required.
golden_sql: SELECT product_name FROM offer_items_view WHERE offer_heading = 'Summer Offer';
must_not_rules: no items from 'Summer Offer for T-Shirt' included

question: Which shops have expired insurance documents?
origin_context: Checking missing insurance document file paths in shop details.
golden_sql: SELECT name, phone FROM shop_details WHERE status = 1 AND (insurance IS NULL OR insurance = '');

question: Find the 5 most expensive products we have listed.
origin_context: Joining products table to active offer prices.
golden_sql: SELECT p.product_name, o.offer_price FROM products p JOIN offer o ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE o.status = 1 ORDER BY o.offer_price DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What is the most popular service offered right now?
origin_context: Tracing popularity from service through active offer to bookings.
golden_sql: SELECT s.service_name, COUNT(b.id) AS booking_count FROM service s JOIN offer o ON o.service_id = s.id JOIN bookings b ON b.offer_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 1 AND b.status = 1 GROUP BY s.id, s.service_name ORDER BY booking_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many active offers have a redemption limit set?
origin_context: A limit of '0' means unlimited. Offers with a non-zero limit have a redemption cap. Replaces the 'hit their limit' idea, because available_limit goes negative on unlimited offers.
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS limited_offers FROM offer WHERE status = 1 AND `limit` IS NOT NULL AND `limit` <> '0';

question: How many active offers use each coupon type?
origin_context: Group count by coupon_type. Expected: type 1 = 29, type 2 = 179, type 3 = 4. Replaces a 211-row listing that exceeds the 200-row limit.
golden_sql: SELECT coupon_type, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM offer WHERE status = 1 GROUP BY coupon_type;

question: How many shops have both an active product offer and an active service offer?
origin_context: Counts shops with at least one active offer of each kind. Product and service ids store 0 (not NULL) when empty, so both must be checked as > 0.
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS dual_model_shops FROM (SELECT shop_id FROM offer WHERE status = 1 GROUP BY shop_id HAVING SUM(product_id IS NOT NULL AND product_id > 0) > 0 AND SUM(service_id IS NOT NULL AND service_id > 0) > 0) x;

question: Find any shop details where the website link is broken or empty.
origin_context: Checking missing website link strings on active records.
golden_sql: SELECT name FROM shop_details WHERE status = 1 AND (websitelink IS NULL OR websitelink = '');

question: Which active offers end this month?
origin_context: Dynamic month and year extraction on end_date fields.
golden_sql: SELECT offer_heading, end_date FROM offer WHERE status = 1 AND YEAR(end_date) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AND MONTH(end_date) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE);

question: What is the average discount provided by each shop category?
origin_context: Inline arithmetic calculation inside an aggregate function.
golden_sql: SELECT c.categoriesname, ROUND(AVG(o.actual_price - o.offer_price), 2) AS avg_discount_amount FROM categories c JOIN offer o ON o.category_id = c.id WHERE o.status = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.categoriesname;

question: Show me all views that happened between 2 AM and 4 AM.
origin_context: Using hour extraction functions on timestamps.
golden_sql: SELECT * FROM views WHERE HOUR(created_at) BETWEEN 2 AND 4;

question: Are there any offers priced at zero?
origin_context: Zero value verification check on offer prices.
golden_sql: SELECT offer_heading FROM offer WHERE status = 1 AND offer_price = 0;

question: Who owns the shop 'Grace fusion cafe'?
origin_context: Tracing business entity name back to partner user profile.
golden_sql: SELECT u.name, u.email FROM users u JOIN shop_details sd ON sd.partner_id = u.id WHERE sd.name = 'Grace fusion cafe';

question: How many active shops are in each category?
origin_context: Counts active shops per category. Replaces a 204-row listing that exceeds the agent's 200-row limit.
golden_sql: SELECT c.categoriesname, COUNT(sd.id) AS shop_count FROM shop_details sd JOIN categories c ON c.id = sd.category_id WHERE sd.status = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.categoriesname;

question: How many quick mode offers do we have active right now?
origin_context: Filtering for boolean quick_mode flag.
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM offer WHERE status = 1 AND quick_mode = 1;

question: Which shops have uploaded all 3 product images for their offers?
origin_context: Multi-column NOT NULL constraint check across image slots.
golden_sql: SELECT DISTINCT sd.name FROM shop_details sd JOIN offer o ON o.shop_id = sd.id WHERE o.product_img1 IS NOT NULL AND o.product_img2 IS NOT NULL AND o.product_img3 IS NOT NULL;

question: Count the total number of products ever listed.
origin_context: Scalar row count on products table.
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products;

question: Which shop categories get viewed the most?
origin_context: 3-table join linking categories to views via shop details.
golden_sql: SELECT c.categoriesname, COUNT(v.id) AS total_views FROM categories c JOIN shop_details sd ON sd.category_id = c.id JOIN views v ON v.shop_id = sd.id GROUP BY c.id, c.categoriesname ORDER BY total_views DESC;

question: Which city generates the highest booking revenue?
origin_context: Geospatial aggregation of completed bookings by default address city.
golden_sql: SELECT sa.city, SUM(b.final_amount) AS revenue FROM bookings b JOIN shop_address sa ON sa.shop_id = b.shop_id WHERE sa.is_default = 1 AND b.status = 1 GROUP BY sa.city ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Show me the worst-rated shops in Trivandrum.
origin_context: Ascending rating sort with fuzzy location mapping (Trivandrum/Thiruvananthapuram).
golden_sql: SELECT sd.name, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM shop_details sd JOIN reviews r ON r.shop_id = sd.id JOIN shop_address sa ON sa.shop_id = sd.id WHERE sa.is_default = 1 AND sa.city IN ('Trivandrum', 'Thiruvananthapuram') AND sd.status = 1 GROUP BY sd.id, sd.name ORDER BY avg_rating ASC LIMIT 5;

question: Did anyone leave a 1-star review this week?
origin_context: Extracting negative feedback within a 7-day relative interval.
golden_sql: SELECT u.name, r.reviewtext, sd.name FROM reviews r JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id JOIN shop_details sd ON sd.id = r.shop_id WHERE r.rating = 1 AND r.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 7 DAY;

question: Are there any bookings where the final amount was higher than the actual amount?
origin_context: Intra-row column comparison testing for anomalies.
golden_sql: SELECT id, final_amount, actual_amount FROM bookings WHERE final_amount > actual_amount;

question: What's the average discount percentage we give overall?
origin_context: Inline ratio math with division-by-zero protection.
golden_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(discount / actual_amount * 100), 2) AS avg_discount_pct FROM bookings WHERE actual_amount > 0 AND status = 1;

question: List the pincodes where we have the most active shops.
origin_context: Grouping by default address pincodes.
golden_sql: SELECT pincode, COUNT(shop_id) AS shop_count FROM shop_address WHERE is_default = 1 GROUP BY pincode ORDER BY shop_count DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Find shops that have 'hotel' in the name but are not categorized as restaurants.
origin_context: Fuzzy string match combined with schema quirk exclusion ('Restaurent').
golden_sql: SELECT sd.name FROM shop_details sd JOIN subcategories sc ON sc.id = sd.subcategory_id WHERE sd.name LIKE '%hotel%' AND sc.subcategoryname != 'Restaurent';

question: What is the longest review anyone has ever written?
origin_context: String length ordering on review text payloads.
golden_sql: SELECT reviewtext, LENGTH(reviewtext) AS chars FROM reviews ORDER BY LENGTH(reviewtext) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many bookings were rejected or cancelled?
origin_context: Filtering for inactive booking status codes (status = 0).
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookings WHERE status = 0;

question: Which shops have exactly a 5.0 average rating with more than 10 reviews?
origin_context: Multi-condition HAVING clause validating perfection and volume.
golden_sql: SELECT sd.name FROM shop_details sd JOIN reviews r ON r.shop_id = sd.id WHERE sd.status = 1 GROUP BY sd.id, sd.name HAVING AVG(r.rating) = 5.0 AND COUNT(r.id) > 10;
must_not_rules: no low volume or low rating shops included

question: List all users who have booked the same shop 3 or more times.
origin_context: Customer loyalty audit via multi-grouping and threshold filters.
golden_sql: SELECT u.name, sd.name AS shop_name, COUNT(b.id) AS visits FROM bookings b JOIN users u ON u.id = b.requester_id JOIN shop_details sd ON sd.id = b.shop_id WHERE b.status = 1 GROUP BY b.requester_id, b.shop_id HAVING COUNT(b.id) >= 3;

question: Who are the top 3 biggest spenders on our app?
origin_context: Aggregating total successful spending per user profile.
golden_sql: SELECT u.name, SUM(b.final_amount) AS total_spent FROM users u JOIN bookings b ON b.requester_id = u.id WHERE b.status = 1 GROUP BY u.id, u.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 3;

question: Are there any addresses in our database lacking latitude or longitude?
origin_context: Geospatial coordinate completeness audit.
golden_sql: SELECT city, arearoadname FROM shop_address WHERE latitude IS NULL OR longitude IS NULL;

question: Find the daily revenue trend for the last 5 days.
origin_context: Dynamic date grouping over a 5-day sliding window.
golden_sql: SELECT DATE(created_at) AS booking_date, SUM(final_amount) AS daily_revenue FROM bookings WHERE status = 1 AND created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 5 DAY GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY booking_date;

question: Which offer had the highest single discount amount?
origin_context: Sorting transactions by highest discount value.
golden_sql: SELECT o.offer_heading, b.discount FROM bookings b JOIN offer o ON o.id = b.offer_id ORDER BY b.discount DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many shops have multiple addresses?
origin_context: Subquery counting groups with greater than 1 address entry.
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT shop_id FROM shop_address GROUP BY shop_id HAVING COUNT(id) > 1) AS multi_address_shops;

question: What's the total number of bookings in Nagercoil?
origin_context: Tracing geographic location constraints through default addresses.
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(b.id) FROM bookings b JOIN shop_address sa ON sa.shop_id = b.shop_id WHERE sa.is_default = 1 AND sa.city = 'Nagercoil' AND b.status = 1;

question: Find any reviews that mention the word 'terrible'.
origin_context: Basic wildcard text pattern matching on reviews.
golden_sql: SELECT u.name, r.reviewtext FROM reviews r JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.reviewtext LIKE '%terrible%';

question: Which shop partner has the most businesses registered?
origin_context: Grouping shop registrations by partner owner ID.
golden_sql: SELECT u.name, COUNT(sd.id) AS shop_count FROM users u JOIN shop_details sd ON sd.partner_id = u.id GROUP BY u.id, u.name ORDER BY shop_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Show me all reviews left for the shop 'A1 Juice house'.
origin_context: Entity name lookup joining reviews to specific shop records.
golden_sql: SELECT r.rating, r.reviewtext FROM reviews r JOIN shop_details sd ON sd.id = r.shop_id WHERE sd.name = 'A1 Juice house';

question: How many bookings did we have at exactly 12:00 PM today?
origin_context: Precise time component matching on current date.
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookings WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURRENT_DATE AND HOUR(created_at) = 12 AND MINUTE(created_at) = 0;

question: Is anyone booking things at cities that are not Nagercoil or Trivandrum?
origin_context: Exclusion list filtering (NOT IN) across default city addresses.
golden_sql: SELECT DISTINCT sa.city FROM bookings b JOIN shop_address sa ON sa.shop_id = b.shop_id WHERE sa.is_default = 1 AND sa.city NOT IN ('Nagercoil', 'Trivandrum', 'Thiruvananthapuram');

question: Find all shops created on a weekend.
origin_context: String to date conversion evaluating weekend day-of-week codes.
golden_sql: SELECT name, created_at FROM shop_details WHERE DAYOFWEEK(STR_TO_DATE(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')) IN (1, 7);

question: What is the average price of plans currently active?
origin_context: Scalar average aggregate on active subscription plans.
golden_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(price), 2) FROM plans WHERE status = 1;

question: List the top 3 most commonly booked categories.
origin_context: Deep multi-table join aggregating transaction volume by category.
golden_sql: SELECT c.categoriesname, COUNT(b.id) AS bookings FROM bookings b JOIN shop_details sd ON sd.id = b.shop_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = sd.category_id WHERE b.status = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.categoriesname ORDER BY bookings DESC LIMIT 3;

question: Show me the Bevereges shops.
origin_context: Handling user typo ('Bevereges') mapping to correct schema substring.
golden_sql: SELECT sd.name FROM shop_details sd JOIN subcategories sc ON sc.id = sd.subcategory_id WHERE sc.subcategoryname LIKE '%Beverages%' AND sd.status = 1;

question: Are there any users who booked an offer that they created themselves?
origin_context: Cross-table foreign key equality check detecting self-booking anomalies.
golden_sql: SELECT u.name, o.offer_heading FROM bookings b JOIN users u ON u.id = b.requester_id JOIN offer o ON o.id = b.offer_id WHERE o.user_id = b.requester_id;

question: What is the month-over-month growth in user signups?
origin_context: Grouping annual signups by month for trend reporting.
golden_sql: SELECT MONTH(created_at) AS month, COUNT(id) AS signups FROM users WHERE YEAR(created_at) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY MONTH(created_at) ORDER BY month;

question: Find the user with the longest name.
origin_context: String length sorting on user names.
golden_sql: SELECT name FROM users ORDER BY LENGTH(name) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many shops have NO vehicle numbers registered?
origin_context: Checking missing vehicle number fields.
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shop_details WHERE vechicle_no IS NULL OR vechicle_no = '';

question: Which cities have exactly 1 shop registered?
origin_context: Group-by condition matching a strict count threshold (HAVING COUNT = 1).
golden_sql: SELECT sa.city FROM shop_address sa JOIN shop_details sd ON sd.id = sa.shop_id WHERE sd.status = 1 AND sa.is_default = 1 GROUP BY sa.city HAVING COUNT(sd.id) = 1;

question: Show me all bookings made by male users for beauty services.
origin_context: Combining user demographic codes with category string matching.
golden_sql: SELECT b.id FROM bookings b JOIN users u ON u.id = b.requester_id JOIN shop_details sd ON sd.id = b.shop_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = sd.category_id WHERE u.gender = 1 AND c.categoriesname LIKE '%Beauty%';

question: List all the offers that start tomorrow.
origin_context: Forward-looking interval date filter (+ 1 day).
golden_sql: SELECT offer_heading FROM offer WHERE start_date = CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND status = 1;

question: Find shops where their actual price and coupon price are exactly the same.
origin_context: Intra-row column equivalence check.
golden_sql: SELECT sd.name, o.offer_heading FROM offer o JOIN shop_details sd ON sd.id = o.shop_id WHERE o.actual_price = o.coupon_price AND o.status = 1;

question: Who are the admins?
origin_context: Internal user type mapping lookup.
golden_sql: SELECT name, email FROM users WHERE user_type = 1;

question: Are there any offers with missing images?
origin_context: Null or empty string checks on offer image attributes.
golden_sql: SELECT offer_heading FROM offer WHERE status = 1 AND (offer_image IS NULL OR offer_image = '');

question: What is the average number of days an offer is valid for?
origin_context: Applying DATEDIFF date arithmetic inside an aggregate function.
golden_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF(end_date, start_date)), 2) AS avg_validity_days FROM offer WHERE start_date IS NOT NULL AND end_date IS NOT NULL;

question: Find the most recently updated shop profile.
origin_context: String-to-date casting for timestamp sorting descending.
golden_sql: SELECT name, updated_at FROM shop_details ORDER BY STR_TO_DATE(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which users have never updated their profile since creating it?
origin_context: Direct timestamp equality comparison between created_at and updated_at.
golden_sql: SELECT name FROM users WHERE created_at = updated_at;

question: Show me all reviews that contain emojis or weird characters.
origin_context: Regular expression pattern matching to isolate non-standard text strings.
golden_sql: SELECT reviewtext FROM reviews WHERE reviewtext NOT REGEXP '^[a-zA-Z0-9[:space:][:punct:]]+$';

question: How many distinct phone numbers are tied to shops?
origin_context: Scalar count distinct on shop contact numbers.
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT phone) FROM shop_details WHERE phone IS NOT NULL AND phone != '';

question: List the shops that have 'juice' or 'shakes' in their name.
origin_context: Logical OR pattern matching across text name fields.
golden_sql: SELECT name FROM shop_details WHERE status = 1 AND (name LIKE '%juice%' OR name LIKE '%shakes%');

question: Is anyone booking things at 3 AM?
origin_context: Hour extraction filter matching early morning transaction windows.
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookings WHERE HOUR(created_at) = 3;

question: Which shops have a review rating, but have zero bookings?
origin_context: Combining an inner review join with a left-join anti-pattern.
golden_sql: SELECT DISTINCT sd.name FROM shop_details sd JOIN reviews r ON r.shop_id = sd.id LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.shop_id = sd.id WHERE b.id IS NULL AND sd.status = 1;

question: Just give me everything you have on 'Boss App Studio Pvt Ltd'.
origin_context: Unified multi-table entity join satisfying wide open exploratory retrieval.
golden_sql: SELECT sd.*, sa.*, c.categoriesname FROM shop_details sd LEFT JOIN shop_address sa ON sa.shop_id = sd.id LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = sd.category_id WHERE sd.name = 'Boss App Studio Pvt Ltd';

question: how many shops are there in Kanyakumari?

golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS shop_count FROM shop_details sd JOIN shop_address sa ON sa.shop_id = sd.id WHERE sd.status = 1 AND sa.is_default = 1 AND sa.city IN ('Kanyakumari', 'Kanniyakumari');

question: which type of business is most common on our app?

question: which shops haven't put up any offers yet?

question: which shop do customers write the most reviews for?

question: whose page are people checking out the most?

question: looking for a cupboard, any deals going?

question: which deal saves me the most money?
origin_context: 'Saves the most' means biggest gap between actual price and offer price among active offers. Check output for the top value and that no tie exists.
golden_sql: SELECT sd.name, o.offer_heading, (o.actual_price - o.offer_price) AS saving FROM offer o JOIN shop_details sd ON sd.id = o.shop_id WHERE o.status = 1 AND o.actual_price > o.offer_price ORDER BY saving DESC, o.id ASC LIMIT 1;
